integrity: The all-size determinant is proved by exact polynomial leaf elimination. Finite exact symbolic and rational cases corroborate but do not substitute for its proof; older compartmental generalized-tree observability may cover the qualitative zero criterion, and historical priority of the complete determinant remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Finite acyclic rooted linear drainage; known depletion/transfer coefficients, no external input during recession, noiseless exact outlet trace; does not address unknown flow inputs, nonlinearities, parameter identification, sampling noise or conditioning.
title: An exact branch-collision determinant for one-gauge linear drainage trees
